about: Every recorded production Firestore Enterprise text-search case replayed through the local engine: membership rows for the 223 distinct cases of all 531 responses, order rows for the 168 cases with two or more results (score-sorted and default; their membership is repeated there), and Boundary03 membership for both rounds. A membership difference is KNOWN_DIFFERENCE only when it is a named closure known difference (knownDifference), otherwise MISMATCH. Where membership differs, order is MATCH_COMMON_MEMBERS when two or more common members keep production order and NOT_COMPARABLE when fewer than two are common. expected is the production response (order kept where it has two or more results), actual the local answer. Numeric score() values are not compared.
